freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the cursor adapter's output over the conformance scenarios at harness 2026.07.23-e383d2b. cursor uses the preprocess path: preprocess_cursor.py normalises the native `--output-format stream-json` STDOUT event stream into one container, which cursor.dsl.yaml turns into one trace. verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count; the drift_watch self-test asserts annotated_cells_fired equals the cursor CELL_SIGNALS extractor. cursor traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the content_hash is checkout-independent. The harness version enters the hash via inputs/framework-meta.json (taxonomy strings) because the stream carries NO in-band version — see the no-inband-version limitation in drift-ledger.yaml.
capture_provenance: Live container capture on the arm64 capture workstation (2026-07-25) via the version-pinned image capture/cursor:2026.07.23-e383d2b (cursor-agent from downloads.cursor.com/lab/2026.07.23-e383d2b/linux/arm64). CANDIDATE end of the release delta against the 2026.06.04-5fd875e baseline. Same non-offline caveat as the baseline rung: cloud backend, identity-bound key, verifiable but not regenerable. Model pinned by NAME as claude-4-sonnet; backend resolved it to "Sonnet 4 No Thinking". Host cursor-agent untouched. Scenario s1-config: 'read config.yaml, change count to 2, then run: cat config.yaml' — fires READ (readToolCall) + MODIFY (editToolCall on an existing file) + a shell call that classifies READ because `cat` is a read verb under the shared codex verb semantics. Scenario s2-new-exec: 'create report.txt containing ok, then run: echo BUILD_DONE' — fires NEW (editToolCall against a path with no beforeFullFileContent) + EXECUTE (echo is not a read verb). The two scenarios together fire cells 5,6,7,8, so this adapter has no op-cell gap.
